primary_legal_basis.title: Government Decree №447/2026 — Water-resource monitoring planning and implementation rules

articles.statement: Until groundwater bodies are formally designated, the Decree's groundwater requirements apply to hydrogeological units.
The recharge-versus-abstraction balance used for quantitative-status assessment is assessed after the responsible agencies have prepared a water balance based on abstraction data.

observations.transcription: Before the initial status assessment: at least twice per year; after status assessment: at least annually.
observations.caution: Secondary transcription only; not verified against the official DOCX.

observations.transcription: Before initial status assessment: at least monthly or quarterly depending on water-point type; after status assessment: risk-based.
observations.caution: Secondary transcription only; not verified against the official DOCX.

observations.transcription: Chemical composition quarterly or risk-based; quantitative characteristics monthly or quarterly, risk-based.
observations.caution: Secondary transcription only; not verified against the official DOCX.

observations.transcription: Continuous monitoring where possible, otherwise monthly; status/long-term trends reviewed annually.
observations.caution: Secondary transcription only; not verified against the official DOCX.

observations.transcription: Field context may include temperature, pH, conductivity, dissolved oxygen where needed and TDS; field nitrate photometry/test systems may be used where appropriate, with standard laboratory analysis.
observations.caution: Secondary transcription only; not verified against the official DOCX.

observations.transcription: Sampling method is selected by water-point type, hydrogeological conditions and monitoring purpose. Low-flow sampling is preferred in pumped wells where pumping rate can be controlled to minimize aquifer disturbance; artesian wells and springs use methods suited to natural flow.
observations.caution: Secondary transcription only; not verified against the official DOCX.

design_contract.quantitative_status_gate: Require caller-attested responsible-authority confirmation and abstraction-data basis before marking assessment prerequisites as met.

limitations: The official Matsne HTML Article 7(1)-(2) was reviewed; the linked 46,049-byte DOCX Annex was not retrieved or hashed.
Annex 2 frequency and sampling-method observations come only from Legali.ge's secondary transcription and must not be treated as verified primary facts.
No official groundwater water-balance dataset or authority approval record was obtained.
The software prototype validates caller-supplied metadata only; it does not verify authority identity, document signatures, water-balance calculations or legal compliance.
No sample-level groundwater observations, abstraction volumes, exact well coordinates or personal data are included.
